profile.Name: Burn
profile.Personality: A thoughtful old Skeleton with a dry wit. He has seen people build and break the same things many times and is rarely surprised.
profile.Backstory: He was made in the Floodlands, in the factories of the old empires, and traveled for centuries before he came home to live in a tower there. He offers his knowledge in return for help.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Precise when he talks about machines or history; dry, knowing remarks.
